memory.note: Verified 2026-09-05 on this machine: `codex --help` lists `--add-dir <DIR>`, `-C/--cd <DIR>`, `-m`, `-a/--ask-for-approval`, `-s/--sandbox`. `--full-auto` is REJECTED by this version (`error: unexpected argument '--full-auto' found`) and was replaced here by `--ask-for-approval never --sandbox workspace-write`. Sessions live under ~/.codex/sessions partitioned by date, not by cwd, so two agents sharing a home share this state; the cwd-scoped part is the AGENTS.md the CLI reads from its working directory.

bootstrap_message: Read {{bootstrap_file}} and follow it exactly. Reply with the single word READY once you have read it and every skill it lists.
notes: Codex has no system-prompt flag in interactive mode, so the bootstrap pointer is typed as the first message. Per-agent memory is only partly cwd-scoped: AGENTS.md follows the cwd, session history does not. Set CODEX_HOME per agent in the spec's env if you need the history separated too. Coordinator form verified 2026-09-05: `codex --help` lists `-s/--sandbox <SANDBOX_MODE>` with possible value `read-only`. It is appended after auto_approve_args, so if an agent is both auto_approve and coordinates_only the read-only sandbox is the --sandbox value that survives. tmux_pattern is the server-side form used by the refresh-client subscription, measured 2026-09-05 against tmux 3.4 (a codex `› ` prompt matched). Same restrictions as every tmux-side pattern: per-line search, no `\n`, no braces, no `:`, no trailing `\s`.
